weatherSettings.title: Weather on Overview
weatherSettings.subtitle: Show the current weather in your Overview clock card
weatherSettings.toggleDesc: When on, Shiranami fetches the current weather for the city you choose from Open-Meteo. Off by default — nothing leaves your machine until you enable it and pick a city.
weatherSettings.cityHelp: Type a city and press search. Only the city name and its rounded coordinates are sent to Open-Meteo.
weatherSettings.noMatches: No matches for that city. Try a different spelling.
weatherSettings.lookupError: Couldn't reach the weather service. Try again.
weatherSettings.note: Powered by Open-Meteo. No account, no API key — only a city name and rounded coordinates leave your machine, and only after you opt in.
